generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the dependency-free Python 3.11+ iCalendar tool.

- Entry point: [main.py](/workspace/output/main.py)
- Executable: [ical](/workspace/output/ical)
- Core parser/expander: [ical_core.py](/workspace/output/ical_core.py)

It supports `parse` and `expand`, RFC-style recurrence/overrides, in-file VTIMEZONE resolution, RFC extension schemas, warnings, and JSON error output. I also verified compilation and CLI invocation.
